notes: Key story sequence: peddler walks, naps under tree, wakes to find monkeys have taken all his caps, shakes fist in anger, monkeys mimic and throw caps down. Colours of caps (gray own cap, then checked, red, blue, brown stacked) are central to the story — gray and red selected as most iconic/useful; 'shake' and 'throw' are the two pivotal action words. 'angry' is already in aac_extras so the PNG may exist; 'shake' is also in aac_extras. Words 'peddler', 'caps', 'tree', and 'monkeys' exist in activity_images already — corresponding fringe words here ('cap', 'monkey', 'tree') should reuse those assets where filenames match.
